name: Cannoli Siciliani
description: Crispy fried pastry tubes filled with sweet sheep's milk ricotta, chocolate chips, and candied orange peel.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
a generous spoonful of Parmesan cheese
a generous handful of yellow onions
a generous spoonful of balsamic vinegar
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the spaghetti and cracked black pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the extra-virgin olive oil with the whole milk until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
Bring your extra-virgin olive oil to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
